en: The front of the postcard shows a modernist white building with geometric patterned windows, wide steps leading to the entrance, and a surrounding landscape featuring mature trees and greenery. The back contains multilingual text in Bulgarian, French, German, and English describing the site as the museum building of the 'Park-Museum of Combat Friendship 1444' in Varna, Bulgaria. There are also stamps, a red handwritten date, and printed details.
